note: NHL zfix input definition corrections (see archetype_patches/NHL_zfix.json).

nhl.coach_expectation_delta.measurement: P_exp = 0.6*points pct (season-1) + 0.4*points pct (season-2), plus nhl.prior_to_current_blend roster-change term (minutes-weighted 3-season RAPM of arrivals minus departures, per 82 games, converted at 0.015 pts pct per goal/60-game); computed in-house so no archived preseason projection is required. Delta_t = points pct to date (games before as-of date t) minus P_exp; SE = sqrt(p(1-p)/n_games_played). Final delta per simulation = (banked points + simulated rest-of-season points from the joint season simulation nhl.season_sim_distribution)/(2*82) minus P_exp. Jack Adams choice model (this input is its canonical home; nhl.award_vote_share_model does not carry it): candidate set = every head coach who ran >=41 regular-season games of one team (about 32); U_c = b1*Delta_final + b2*(Delta_final - Delta_prev_season) + b3*first_year_with_team; P(win) = exp(U_c)/sum_j exp(U_j), averaged over simulations (a coach fired before the threshold drops out of that draw). Fit as a conditional logit on winners 2005-06 onward, augmented with a rank-ordered (exploded) logit on the NHLBA top-3 finish order from published 5-3-1 point totals; ridge penalty chosen by leave-one-season-out log loss; at most 3 covariates. Use only games before t.

nhl.award_vote_share_model.measurement: For each award collect the last 20 seasons' finalists and vote shares; regress log vote share on points per game, goals, team points percentage, games played, position and for goalies wins, save percentage and shutouts; fit multinomial logit with season fixed effects and shrinkage; apply to the projected end-of-season stat line distribution from simulations; output win probability by candidate with draw uncertainty; update with finalists and ballot dates. Source caveat (SOURCE_UNVERIFIED for the Ted Lindsay Award): full vote shares are not known to be published for player-voted awards (only finalists and the winner), so where shares are missing fit a conditional-logit on winner-among-finalists instead of a share regression; with only a few dozen finalists per award use at most 4 covariates and strong shrinkage. Coach branch (Jack Adams): not modelled in this input; the coach-level conditional logit over all ~32 head coaches (NHL Broadcasters' Association electorate, 5-3-1 ballot, individual ballots unpublished) is specified in nhl.coach_expectation_delta, and no player production covariates apply to it.

nhl.award_voting_rules.mechanism: Static map of each award's electorate, ballot and timing: PHWA writers vote the Hart, Norris and Calder, general managers the Vezina, NHLPA players the Ted Lindsay, and the NHL Broadcasters' Association the Jack Adams (5-3-1 three-name ballot, individual ballots unpublished); ballots are cast after the regular season. The fitted player-award vote model is nhl.award_vote_share_model; the Jack Adams coach-level model is specified in nhl.coach_expectation_delta.

nhl.standings_stakes.rationale: Late-season games have heterogeneous effort and rest. Clinched teams rest stars (last 2-5 games); eliminated bottom teams sell veterans at the deadline, play call-ups and backup goalies, which lowers their points rate below the pre-deadline rating; the lottery incentive is weak since the worst team has only 18.5% first-draw odds (16.6% in 2021) and, in the two-draw format (2021 onward), it cannot fall below third because only two clubs can jump it (the 10-spot cap limits how far a draw winner can rise, not how far the worst team falls; the 2016-2020 three-draw format allowed a fall to fourth), so the effect must be estimated and shrunk, not assumed.
